title: The Tamer's Field Guide
objective: Collect every subject and earn your Graduation.
rules: Choose three distinct subjects from your collection before an encounter.
Wild subjects are chosen by credit value and never repeat a subject you own.
The wild boss gains 150% HP, Attack, and Defense for the encounter (2.5x total).
A coin toss decides who strikes first. Choose one living ally for each attack.
The boss answers with a random strike against one of your living allies.
A victory adds the boss at its normal stats. A defeat grants no subject.
Every encounter restores your team. Battles are unlimited.
Department matchups can strengthen a strike or expose a weakness.
